title: Gilda Lozoya Granted Conditional Release Pending Formal Charges
detail: A federal judge granted Gilda Lozoya Austin conditional release on July 3, 2026, a day after her detention in the Agronitrogenados money-laundering case. She must surrender her passport, wear an electronic tracking device, report to authorities every 15 days, and may not leave the Mexico City metropolitan area or the country. A subsequent hearing was set to determine whether she will be formally linked to the criminal process ('vinculación a proceso').

media.caption: El Financiero: Gilda, sister of Emilio Lozoya, receives conditional release
